Synopsis:
The Trump administration has imposed new sanctions on five Cuban entities — including a state bank, nickel mining companies, and energy sector firms — alongside Raul Castro's grandson. The U.S. has also enforced an oil blockade on Cuba since early 2026, worsening an already fragile power grid and triggering nationwide blackouts. The UN has flagged humanitarian crisis risks. Cuba is responding by opening key economic sectors to private industry.
